name_input: SPRINT EXPORTS PVT LTD; SPRINT EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for SPRINT EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED (OCEAN PARK APTS, OPP: WOMENS HOSTEL BEACH ROAD, MAHARANIPETA — Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh) reports "Total Shipments 1115", "Trading Partners 16", "Ports 21", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-27". Exact record line: "2026-02-19 | SPRINT EXPORTS PRIVATE LIMITED | IMAMURA JOINT VENTURES CORPORATION | FROZEN OTHER THAN AFD RAW VANNAMEI SHRIMPS(BACK CUT PD). PKG: 2 KGS X 6 BLOCKS,BR: SPRINT GOLD, GRADE: 20/40 -1500 CTNS- VIZAG SEA | INVTZ1, India | Tokyo, JAPAN | 03061720 | 9826028". Additional dated records seen: 2026-02-27 → STERLING SEAFOOD CORP., New York, USA, HS 16052900, B/L 1078957; 2026-02-26 → STERLING SEAFOOD CORP., New York, USA, HS 16052900, B/L 1051065; 2026-02-23 → STERLING SEAFOOD CORP., New York, USA, HS 16052900, B/L 9919962; 2026-02-20 → STERLING SEAFOOD CORP., New York, USA, HS 16052900, B/L 9854039. Top port lanes listed: VIZAG SEA INVTZ1 (88), New York (73), VIZAG SEA (31), Newark (18), GANGAVARAM PORT SEA INGGV1 (9). Source counter: page claims 1115 total shipments; 5 individual shipment rows actually visible on the free view (counter vs rows seen = 1115 vs 5).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real, dated, named-buyer customs/B-L records with HS codes and B/L numbers, destination USA (New York/Newark) and Japan (Tokyo), all ex Visakhapatnam Sea port. IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY: the declared HS 030617 matches only the Japan line (03061720, raw frozen vannamei shrimp); the four US lines are HS 16052900 (prepared/preserved cooked shrimp, 'FROZEN OTHERTHAN AFD COOKED IQF PDT OFFVANNAMEI WHITE SHRIMPS', brand SPRINT GOLD). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the actual HS should be recorded as dual: 03061720 (raw frozen) and 16052900 (cooked/processed). Also note the state_claimed 'Kerala' does not match the customs address (Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh) — the entity appears to be an Andhra Pradesh/Vizag-based shrimp processor-exporter, not Kerala; state should be corrected. A separate, unrelated 'SPRINT EXPORTS PVT. LTD.' at 10-50-84/C Sun Towers, Waltair Main Road, Visakhapatnam appears in ImportKey as an IMPORTER of food-processing machinery from GLORY CO., LTD. (Vietnam) — do not conflate the two records. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search backend returned connection refused and eximpedia/volza returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found — absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not a finding. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public on free views, not invented).
